tools.name: search_husverket
tools.description: Search Husverket's knowledge base of 350 Swedish house-building questions (attefallshus, fritidshus, prices, drawings, building permits, choosing a builder). Returns the best-matching answers with the husverket.se source. Use for any question about building, buying, pricing, permits, or floor plans

tools.name: get_answer
tools.description: Get the full bilingual answer for a specific knowledge-base entry by its id (e.g. q001).

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the 7 Husverket knowledge categories and how many questions each contains.

tools.name: get_company_info
tools.description: Get verified facts about Husverket AB: founding, size, products, technical specs, warranties, delivery and trust signals. Use when asked who Husverket is or why choose them.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Get Husverket's 2026 turnkey prices (from SEK) for attefallshus and fritidshus. Optionally filter by category or max price.

tools.name: list_house_models
tools.description: List Husverket's house models (attefallshus, attefallshus med källare, fritidshus, friggebod) with size in m2, link to the model page on husverket.se and the confirmed price where available. Filter by type and/or size range.
